About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Your Trusted Headwear Manufacturing Partner
About.storyText: Founded in 2015, we have grown from a small workshop into one of the leading headwear manufacturers in China. With over a decade of experience, we serve brands and businesses worldwide with premium quality custom headwear.
About.capacityText: Our state-of-the-art facility spans 2,000m² and houses over 30 skilled workers. Equipped with the latest embroidery machines, cutting equipment, and quality control systems, we can produce over 100,000 pieces per month.
About.certificationsText: Every order is checked at each stage of production, and we confirm every detail with a pre-production sample before bulk production begins.

Custom.subtitle: Bring Your Headwear Vision to Life
Custom.intro: From concept to finished product, we handle every step of the custom manufacturing process. Whether you need 100 or 100,000 pieces, we deliver quality and consistency.
Custom.step1Desc: Share your ideas, logos, and requirements. Our design team will create mockups and samples for your approval.
Custom.step2Desc: Choose from a wide range of fabrics, colors, and accessories. We source premium materials to match your specifications.
Custom.step3Desc: We produce physical samples for your review before mass production begins. Revisions are included.
Custom.step4Desc: Once approved, we begin full production with strict quality control at every stage.
Custom.step5Desc: Every batch undergoes thorough inspection. We provide detailed QC reports with photos.
Custom.step6Desc: We handle packaging and logistics worldwide. FOB, CIF, and door-to-door options available.

FAQ.title: FAQ
FAQ.subtitle: Our most frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1: How long is your production time?
FAQ.a1: Our standard production time is 15–25 days, depending on quantity and customization complexity. Rush orders can be arranged — contact us to discuss your timeline.
FAQ.q2: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
FAQ.a2: Our MOQ starts from 50 pieces per colour. For first-time orders, we offer flexible quantities to help you test the market.
FAQ.q3: Can you produce custom designs with our logo?
FAQ.a3: Absolutely! We offer full customization including embroidery, screen printing, woven labels, patches, and more. Just send us your logo and design requirements.
FAQ.a4: We work with a wide range of materials including cotton twill, polyester, nylon, wool, acrylic, corduroy, and organic/recycled fabrics. We can also source specific materials per your request.
FAQ.a5: We offer FOB, CIF, and door-to-door delivery options worldwide. We work with reliable freight forwarders and can ship by sea, air, or express courier depending on your needs.
FAQ.q6: Do you provide samples before production?
FAQ.a6: Yes, we provide pre-production samples for your approval. Sample production takes 5–7 days. Once approved, we proceed with mass production.

HomeA.lead: A 2,000 m² cap factory in Guangzhou, China — our own cutting, sewing and assembly lines, backed by long-term embroidery, printing and finishing partners. We work directly with brand owners who need a manufacturing partner, not just a listing.
HomeA.capHeading: What we build, and what we build it with
HomeA.capDescription: Specs are locked at sampling, then held through bulk production. Cutting, sewing and assembly run inside our own workshop; embroidery, printing and specialty finishes are handled by long-term partner workshops, and every batch is checked back in before it moves on.
HomeA.specMoqValue: 50 pieces per colour — flexible on first orders while you test a market.
HomeA.specSampleValue: 5–7 days from confirmed artwork and fabric, revisions included.
HomeA.specBulkValue: 15–25 days, depending on quantity and decoration complexity.
HomeA.specMaterialsValue: Cotton twill, polyester, nylon, wool, acrylic, corduroy, organic & recycled fabrics — sourced to spec on request.
HomeA.specShippingValue: FOB · CIF · door-to-door, by sea, air or express courier.
HomeA.specQcValue: Stage-by-stage inline checks during cutting, sewing and decoration, plus a pre-production sample sign-off before any bulk run starts.
HomeA.processHeading: How an order moves through the factory

steps.title: Design & consultation
steps.body: Send your logo, reference styles and target price. We come back with a build sheet and, where useful, a mockup.

steps.title: Material & colour selection
steps.body: Pick fabric, colourway and trims from stock, or source a specific material on request.

steps.title: Sample production
steps.body: A physical sample is cut and sewn in 5–7 days. Revisions are included before you sign off.

steps.title: Bulk production
steps.body: Cutting, sewing, embroidery/print and assembly run under stage-by-stage QC — 15–25 days depending on order size.

steps.title: Final inspection
steps.body: Every batch is checked before packing, with a QC photo report available on request.

steps.title: Shipping
steps.body: FOB, CIF or door-to-door — by sea, air or express, to over 50 countries.

HomeA.contactBody: Send a description, target quantity and any reference images — we'll reply with pricing and a realistic timeline, usually within 24 hours.

HomeB.lead: An independent cap factory producing for brands who care how a curve is stitched and how a colour is matched. We manufacture; you design.
HomeB.capabilityP1: Cutting, sewing and assembly happen inside our own 2,000 m² facility, run by a team of 30+ skilled hands who have worked together for years. Embroidery, printing and washing are handled by partner workshops we've used for years, and every batch comes back to us for checking.
HomeB.capabilityP2: Orders start from 50 pieces per colour. A physical sample is ready in 5–7 days; a confirmed bulk order ships in 15–25 days. Every stage is checked as it happens, and nothing moves to bulk production until you've approved a pre-production sample.
HomeB.collectionNote: Every piece shown is in current production — nothing rendered.
